_meta.source: Hand-authored evaluation scenario (Week 8), designed for this repo -- not derived from an external homework assignment (KidsTube) or an authoritative third-party analysis (Genomic/NIST). Treat its gold standard as AI-assisted-and-reviewed, not independently authoritative; see gold_standard_threats.json's own _meta for the same caveat.
_meta.purpose: An app that shares a child's live location with parents/guardians, for situations like field trips or staying at a friend's house. All flows are Process-mediated (a Process on at least one side of every flow), by design, so every flow is reachable under LINDDUN Pro's Table 4.1 with no effective_type reclassification needed -- deliberately, mirroring smart_home's discipline, to keep this scenario's reachability ceiling equal to its gold-standard size.

flows.description: Child's device transmits live GPS coordinates to the backend at regular intervals
Backend writes each location ping to the Location History Store
Backend forwards new location pings to the Geofencing Engine to check zone entry/exit
Geofencing Engine reads configured zone definitions (home, school, friend's house) from the Family Account Store
Geofencing Engine pushes an arrival/departure notification to the parent when the child enters or exits a defined zone
Parent registers an account, creates the child's profile (name, DOB, school), and defines geofence zones
Backend stores account, child profile, and geofence zone data
Parent requests to view the child's current location or location history on a map
Backend retrieves stored location history to serve the parent's map/history view
Parent invites a secondary guardian (e.g. grandparent, relative) to also view the child's location
Backend grants the secondary guardian access and shares the child's live location with them
Backend shares aggregated usage and engagement analytics with an advertising/analytics partner to fund the app's free tier
Child sends a manual check-in / SOS message with their current location to the parent
